summary: Tucked away within a cul-de-sac in the highly regarded Whinfield area of Darlington, this attractive two-bedroom semi-detached property offers a wonderful opportunity for a wide range of buyers.
description:
With its appealing position, driveway and garage to the front, together with a private garden to the rear, the property provides a practical and comfortable home with plenty to offer. The accommodation is ideally suited to first-time buyers, couples, small families and those looking for a manageable home in a popular residential setting. It could also be of interest to investors seeking a property with strong rental appeal, given the established demand for homes within this convenient area. Upon entering, the property features an entrance hall providing access into the main living accommodation. The lounge offers a comfortable space in which to relax and unwind, while the kitchen provides a practical area for everyday cooking and dining. To the first floor are two well-proportioned double bedrooms together with a family bathroom, creating a straightforward and versatile layout. Externally, the property benefits from a driveway and garage to the front, providing valuable off-road parking and useful additional storage. To the rear is a garden offering a private outdoor space which can be enjoyed by the occupants and provides scope for outdoor seating, entertaining or gardening. The location is a particular attraction. Caithness Way is situated within the established Whinfield residential area, which is well placed for a range of everyday amenities including supermarket, smaller shops, schools and doctors surgery. For those who enjoy outdoor activities, the surrounding area provides access to green spaces and recreational facilities, with North Park, Beech Wood and Rockwell Local Nature Reserve all within the wider Darlington area. There are also local sporting facilities, including the Darlington Education Village and Darlington Golf Club. Transport links are another benefit, with local bus stops located within easy reach of the property and regular services providing connections across Darlington. The A66 and A1(M) are also readily accessible by road, making the location convenient for those commuting throughout Darlington and the wider North East. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the position, accommodation and potential this property has to offer.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a UPVC framed double-glazed door and provides a welcoming entrance to the property. The hall benefits from a radiator, with stairs rising to the first floor and access to the ground floor accommodation.

LOUNGE The spacious lounge is a bright and inviting reception room, benefiting from UPVC framed double-glazed windows to the front and side aspects, allowing an abundance of natural light to fill the room. A feature fire surround with inset and hearth provides an attractive focal point and houses an electric pebble-bed fire. The room is further complemented by laminate flooring and a radiator, creating a comfortable and welcoming space for relaxing and entertaining.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of modern white high-gloss base and wall-mounted units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. There is space for a cooker with a stainless-steel chimney-style extractor hood over, together with space for a tall fridge freezer and plumbing for an automatic washing machine. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light, while a UPVC framed double-glazed door provides direct access to the rear garden. A radiator completes the room.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing provides access to the bedrooms and family bathroom and benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light into the space. There is loft access together with a useful built-in storage cupboard housing the gas central heating combination boiler, providing additional practical storage.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a well-proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, providing plenty of natural light, together with a radiator for warmth and comfort.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is another well-proportioned double bedroom, offering a comfortable and versatile space. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window, providing natural light, together with a radiator.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern suite comprising a panel bath with an inset electric shower over, wash hand basin and WC. The room benefits from part-tiled walls, a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light and ventilation, and a radiator for warmth and comfort.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property is a gravelled, low-maintenance garden area, complemented by a driveway providing ample off-road parking and leading to the garage. The garage also benefits from side door access, providing convenient access to and from the garden. To the rear is a fully enclosed garden, predominantly laid to lawn with a patio area providing an ideal space for outdoor seating and entertaining. The garden enjoys a particularly pleasant position, backing onto green space and therefore benefiting from an open aspect with no properties directly overlooking the rear, creating a good degree of privacy.
